page_title: FUL 1-3 AST | Fulham v Aston Villa 19/10/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+9' The referee blows for the end of today's match.
90+8' Issa Diop (Fulham) takes his opponent down and receives a yellow card from the referee.
90+5' Aston Villa enjoy a period of possession as they are exchanging some passes and waiting for an opportunity to strike.

90+3' Darren England blows his whistle and Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) is shown a second yellow card for his foul. His manager will not be pleased. He has lot of time to think about it as he walks off.
90' We will have 7 min. of added time.
90' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) is clearly in an offside position and the linesman raises his flag.
88' Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa) is shown a yellow card by the referee for making a challenge on his opponent, but he looks angry with the decision.
86' Fulham take the corner, but their hopes of scoring a goal end with a nice clearance by the defence.

85' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends a cross into the box, but the opposition's defence clears the ball away to eliminate the danger. Fulham force a corner. Their opponents will face another attacking threat.
83' This yellow card was deserved. The tackle by Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) was quite harsh and Darren England didn't hesitate to show him a yellow card.
83' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Morgan Rogers walks off the pitch to be replaced by John McGinn (Aston Villa).
83' We are about to witness a substitution. Emiliano Buendia (Aston Villa) is replacing Jacob Ramsey.
81' Fulham quickly take a corner kick with a short pass.
80' Marco Silva has decided to introduce fresh legs, with Harry Wilson (Fulham) replacing Sander Berge.
80' Substitution. Emile Smith Rowe makes his way off the pitch and Tom Cairney (Fulham) comes on as his replacement.
79' The Aston Villa players are exchanging some short passes.
75' Aston Villa failed to take advantage of the corner as the opposition's defence was alert and averted the threat.
75' Unai Emery has decided to make a change. Jhon Duran (Aston Villa) replaces Ollie Watkins.
75' That's the end of the game for Amadou Onana, who is replaced by Ross Barkley (Aston Villa).
74' Neat passing move from Aston Villa in order to create new attacking opportunities.
71' Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) receives a yellow card for a nasty tackle.
69' 1 - 3 An unfortunate own goal is conceded by Issa Diop (Fulham), who attempted to block the ball after a cross, but instead he sends it inside the bottom left corner of his own goal.
68' Marco Silva decides to make a substitution. Adama Traore will be replaced by Reiss Nelson (Fulham).
68' It is time for a substitution. Issa Diop (Fulham) is on for Andreas Pereira.
67' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) steps up to take the corner. He launches the ball into the penalty area, but it only finds the head of an opposing player who clears the danger.
66' Emile Smith Rowe (Fulham) criticises the decision of the referee and immediately receives a yellow card.
64' Joachim Andersen (Fulham) makes a tackle on his opponent and is shown a harsh red card by the referee!
63' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) pounces on a bouncing ball on the edge of the box, but sends his volley well wide of the right post. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
62' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Fulham.
61' Unai Emery prepares a substitution. Leon Bailey is replaced by Jaden Philogene (Aston Villa).
61' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) produces a lovely ball into the penalty area but the defender manages to intercept and comfortably averts the danger. Fulham have been awarded a corner kick.

59' 1 - 2 Goal! Youri Tielemans launched the corner kick and superbly found the head of Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa), whose accurate effort from near the penalty spot went in off the crossbar. It's 1:2.
59' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) will deliver the ball into the penalty box from a corner kick.
59' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Aston Villa comes to nothing.
59' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) strikes the ball towards the right side of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes an easy save. He should have scored that. Aston Villa earn a corner.
57' Calvin Bassey (Fulham) goes into the referee's book for dissent.

57' Fulham slow the tempo of the game down by exchanging a combination of one or two touch passes. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult at the moment, very physically demanding to run without the ball.
56' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) drives a shot towards the bottom right corner from inside the box, but Bernd Leno leaps like a salmon and knocks the ball away.
53' Adama Traore (Fulham) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Emiliano Martinez, who smothers the ball.
52' The corner is swung in but Fulham can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

51' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) passes the ball from the edge of the box in order to find his teammate, who is in a good scoring position, but the defender blocks the pass and spanks the ball to safety. The ball goes out of play. Fulham are awarded a corner kick.
51' Some great controlled play and passing in the middle of the pitch from Fulham.
49' Pau Torres (Aston Villa) commits a rough challenge and Darren England blows his whistle for a foul.
47' Aston Villa seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. Great movement by the offensive players allows the defenders to set up the attack.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+5' Darren England blows his whistle to signal the end of the first-half action.

45+5' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) rises above the defence inside the box to power a fine header, but the goalkeeper is lucky as the ball flies just over the bar. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
45+3' Fulham are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.
45' 4 min. of stoppage-time to be played.
45' The Aston Villa players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.

43' Good chance! Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) nicely turned his man inside the box but placed his effort just wide of the right post. He should have scored! The ball goes out of play and Fulham will have a goal kick.
42' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) sends in a poor cross from the corner and Bernd Leno has no trouble gathering it.

41' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) swings in the corner, but fails to find any of his teammates. One of the defenders reacts superbly to get it clear. Aston Villa will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
41' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) sends in the corner, but fails to find the head of any of his teammates, allowing the defence to clear. Corner kick. Aston Villa will have an opportunity.
40' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) launches an inaccurate corner kick into the penalty area. Aston Villa win a corner.
40' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) sends a sweet pass into the penalty area, but one of the defenders averts the danger. The ball is out of play and Aston Villa manage to earn a corner.

38' Ambitious effort from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa). He finds himself in a great position after collecting a precise pass inside the penalty area and goes for goal, but it never troubles the goalkeeper and flies well wide of the right post.
35' Fulham can’t profit from the corner as the defence clear the ball upfield.
34' Adama Traore (Fulham) slaloms his way past challenges, but an opposing player does well to get the ball away. Now Fulham have a corner.
33' The referee gives a yellow card to Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) for talking back. He must be careful for the remainder of the match.
32' The goalkeeper punched the ball away after Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) took the corner.
32' Leon Bailey (Aston Villa) flights in the cross, but the defender is alert and clears to safety. Aston Villa will take a corner kick.
31' Aston Villa exchange some quick one-two passes over a small area and control the game. Now they make a mistake and lose the ball and the whole situation changes in the blink of an eye.
29' Fulham seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
27' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) wastes a huge opportunity to score from the penalty spot. He attempts to slot into the bottom right corner, but Emiliano Martinez pulls off a superb save.
27' Andreas Pereira (Fulham) is going to take the penalty!
26' Here comes the VAR decision: PENALTY to Fulham!
25' Referee Darren England makes the VAR signal and is going to check whether it’s a penalty for Fulham. Let’s see what happens!
24' Surely that's handball by one of the Aston Villa players in the box, but the referee just waves play on!
23' The referee stops play as the linesman flags Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) offside.
23' The Aston Villa players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
20' Darren England blows for a foul after Diego Carlos (Aston Villa) was too aggressive in the battle for the ball.
18' Ollie Watkins (Aston Villa) takes a wonderful touch after collecting a pass inside the box. He steers his low drive towards the left post, but the keeper dives low to keep the ball out.

17' Long passes, short passes and one-two passes. Aston Villa are showcasing great team work by keeping possession and producing pin-point passes from player to player. The opposition's players are finding it very difficult to intercept at the moment.
16' A corner kick by Aston Villa is thwarted by the well prepared Bernd Leno (Fulham).
16' A cross into the box from Lucas Digne (Aston Villa) is cleared. The referee blows his whistle, Aston Villa are awarded a corner kick.
15' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) takes the corner but only sends it into a huddle of the defenders and one of them makes a good clearance.
15' Jacob Ramsey (Aston Villa) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared. Aston Villa get a corner.
14' Youri Tielemans (Aston Villa) tackles a bit over-zealously and Darren England blows for a foul.
13' A great run from Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) ends with a shot inside the box that flashes just past the right post.
12' Raul Jimenez (Fulham) receives a fine cross inside the box and attempts to score a goal, but his shot flies just wide of the right post.
11' Fulham have been given a corner kick after the ball crosses the byline.
9' 1 - 1 Morgan Rogers (Aston Villa) picks it up in space and from the edge of the box lashes in a shot that is deflected past the helpless Bernd Leno. 1:1.

9' Adama Traore (Fulham) attempted to create a dangerous situation in front of goal by sending a cross into the box, but the defence easily dealt with the threat. The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Aston Villa.
8' Antonee Robinson (Fulham) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

5' 1 - 0 It's a goal! Raul Jimenez (Fulham) darts into the box to collect a fantastic lofted pass from Bernd Leno and unleashes a powerful shot directed into the bottom right corner. The ball bounces in off the post, increasing the score of today's match. It's now 1:0.
4' Aston Villa are showing great team chemistry. They are passing it around beautifully. Excellent team work.
2' Fulham control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
1' Today's match has just started, enjoy the game!
Aston Villa will kick-off.
Today's referee will be Darren England.
